violation_type.title: Infant Care Area - Able to See, Hear and Intervene (26 TAC §746.2403(1))
violation_type.short_title: Infant Care Area - Able to See, Hear and Intervene
violation_type.typical_finding: There were two infants sleeping in pack and plays without a caregiver in the classroom. The infants were 5 & 10 months old.  The infant caregiver was observed in the kitchen area upon entering the center.

finding_variants.text: There were two infants sleeping in pack and plays without a caregiver in the classroom. The infants were 5 & 10 months old.  The infant caregiver was observed in the kitchen area upon entering the center.
A teacher was not present in the area where two infants were sleeping.
The arrangement between the cribs did not allowed caregivers to see all infants at glance.    This was corrected during the inspection.

During an investigation, it was determined an infant was not being interacted with during lunch and was able to fall out of their highchair despite being buckled in. Caregivers were unable to intervene to prevent the fall.
The handwashing sink and diaper changing area were not set up in such a way that caregivers can see and hear infants at all times.

Observed a caregiver taking a child out of a highchair while there were two other older infants on the other side of the wall of the infant room. The caregiver was unable to see the infants or intervene if needed. This was corrected when the caregiver went to where she was able to see all the infants.
